story_overview: At a vintage radio station, producer Arthur oversees engineer Rory as they begin a recording session. In the studio, the talented Esther performs for the executive, Walter. The day continues with Walter holding tense meetings in his office, first with Finn and then with Leo.

video_prompts:
Arthur: Man in his 40s with short, combed dark hair and a neatly trimmed mustache, wearing a charcoal pinstripe single-breasted suit, a white dress shirt, and a narrow dark tie.
Rory: Young man in his early 20s with slicked-back dark hair, wearing thick-framed black plastic eyeglasses and a red and blue plaid shirt.
The Radio Booth: Retro-style radio control room with wood-paneled walls, a large glass window, a desk, and a vintage-style microphone.
the reel-to-reel recorder: Large vintage reel-to-reel tape recorder with a dark wood-grain casing, a silver metal control panel featuring numerous black knobs and switches, two large circular metal reels loaded with thin brown magnetic tape, and a pair of analog VU meters.

Medium shot in The Radio Booth. Rory, wearing the plaid shirt and the black-rimmed eyeglasses, sits in profile at a desk and carefully adjusts the knobs on the reel-to-reel recorder. Arthur stands behind him, leaning forward slightly to watch him work.
In the dimly lit The Radio Booth, a close-up shows Arthur's hand pressing a button on the reel-to-reel recorder. The reels of the tape recorder begin to spin.
Close-up side view in The Radio Booth. The large tape reels of the reel-to-reel recorder spin steadily as it records audio. Arthur leans over the reel-to-reel recorder, intently watching it operate.

video_prompts:
Finn: Younger man with a slim build and short, slightly messy blond hair, wearing a short-sleeve button-up shirt with a brown and orange mid-century geometric pattern, and dark brown trousers.
The Producer's Office: Mid-century style office interior featuring a bookshelf and a vintage radio.
the silver thermos: Sleek, silver-colored metal thermos with a cylindrical body and a matching screw-on cap.
the leather strap wristwatch: Mid-century style men's analog wristwatch with a round, polished silver case, a simple white dial with thin hands, and a worn dark brown leather strap.
the mid-century bookshelf: Tall, dark wood Mid-century modern bookshelf with multiple shelves filled with an assortment of hardcover books in various colors and sizes.
the tabletop radio: Vintage mid-century tabletop radio with a rectangular dark wood veneer case, a light-colored fabric speaker grille on the side, a horizontal analogue tuning dial, and several round control knobs.

Inside the dimly lit The Producer's Office, Walter places the silver thermos on a surface just out of frame. Finn stands near the mid-century bookshelf and the tabletop radio, watching him and shifting his weight slightly. Walter then looks down at his wrist to check the time on the leather strap wristwatch.

Leo: Young man with a nervous energy, short blond hair, wearing a light blue polo shirt and dark trousers.
the executive wood desk: Large mid-century executive desk with a dark, polished wood-grain surface, a rectangular top, and clean lines with slender, tapered legs.
the ceramic coffee cups: Thick-walled, off-white ceramic coffee cups of a classic mid-century diner style, each with a C-shaped handle and a thin dark green band around the outer rim.
the black rotary telephone: Vintage mid-century rotary telephone with a glossy black plastic body, a circular front dial with finger holes, and a heavy matching handset resting in a cradle, connected by a coiled black cord.

Walter sits behind the executive wood desk and gestures while speaking to Leo, who stands opposite him, listening intently. Rory stands nearby, shifting his gaze between the two speakers. On the desk between them are the black rotary telephone and a pair of the ceramic coffee cups.
